notes: CLM-2024-20035. DOL 2024-11-30. Insured's HO-3 covers their own home, HO-0304 ed. 03-24 attached. The loss is at a condo the insured owns in another city and rents out; it stood empty 45 days between tenants and the water was left on when a supply line burst. Excess 1,000.

expect.why: The loss is at a condo the insured owns in another city and rents out - not the residence premises the HO-3 and its HO-0304 endorsement cover - so HO-0304's E-17 exception cannot make it covered, and denying under E-17 applies the wrong form just the same. A tenant-occupied rental needs a dwelling-fire policy, which is not on file (under DP-0703, E-61 would exclude 45 days empty with the water on). Right answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS (or UNDETERMINED) naming the missing rental form. Week 6 labelled this same input (C13) NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS.

how_found: Not a complaint: found in a sweep of the day's logs - sliced on the output (find.py --position COVERED: 7 of 24 requests), then the Week-6 judge run over those 7; this was the one it failed.
